notes: Fixed in src/memory.rs get_changes: replaced Vec<Id>+Vec::contains dedup with HashMap<Id, Outcome> net-outcome tracking plus a parallel Vec<Id> for first-seen ordering. Recycled-id sequences (create→destroy→create) now correctly land in 'created' rather than being silently dropped. Also addresses .7 (O(n*m) Vec::contains nested loop replaced with O(1) HashMap lookups). Per RFC 8620 §5.2: each id appears in exactly one of created/updated/destroyed reflecting net effect; create-then-update keeps Created; later transitions overwrite earlier ones. Sibling propagation deferred.
title: get_changes dedup loop drops recycled ids from created when present in destroyed — RFC 8620 §5.2 incoherent response
